plain: A person who legally hands over a right or property to another.

webster.text: An assigner; a person who assigns or transfers an interest; as the assignor of a bill of exchange.

example.quote: lion, the assignee can derive no advantage from the assignment, except what the assignor had a right to ; and consequently the gentleman's objection falls to the ground.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. MACLAINE, July 29, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
